questions.question:
The following bar graph displays the information about the percentage marks of a student in six different subjects in the examination. The maximum marks of all subject are equal. Study the bar graph carefully and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7607deb17dcd5018e99d41bb1a4c2f98e50a1c461b2aa89982eae86ee974fab.png] 

What is the percentage score of all the six subjects combined?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total subjects = 6

English% = 92%

Hindi% = 87%

Math% = 99%

Physics% = 86%

Chemistry% = 88%

ComputerScience% = 79%

**Formula used:**

Average% = Sum of percentage / Total number of subjects

**Solution:**

Average% = (92 + 87 + 99 + 86 + 88 + 79) / 6

Average% = 531 / 6 

Average% = 88.5%

**Hence, the percentage score of all the six subjects combined is 88.5%**

questions.question: A thief steals a scooter at 1:40 p.m. and drives it at 54 km/h. The theft is discovered at 2:10 p.m. and the owner sets off to chase the thief on another scooter at 72 km/h. At what time will he catch the thief?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed(Thief) = 54km/h

Theif discovered at 2:10 pm

 

Speed(Owner) = 72km/h

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance / Time taken

**Solution:**

Relative speed = 72 - 54 = 18km/h

In one hour the thief will cover 54km.

In half hour( 1:40pm to 2:10pm) he will cover 54/2= 27km

Now, the owner will reach theif in 27/18 = 3/2 hours = 3/2 x 60 minutes = 90 minutes.

so, 2:10 + 90 minutes = 3:40pm

**Hence, the owner will catch the thief at 3:40 pm.**

questions.question: The average age of the father and his five children is 10 years which is decreased by 6 years if the age of the father is excluded. The age of the father is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

(f + 5c)/6 = 10

5c/5 = 10-6

c = average age of children

f = age of the father.

**Solution:**

c = 4

[f + 5(4)] / 6 = 10

f + 20 = 60

f = 60-20 = 40

**Hence, the age of the father is 40 years.**

questions.question: A seller sells oranges at the rate of 10 for Rs. 28, gaining thereby 40%. For how much did he buy a dozen oranges?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total orange = 10

Selling price = Rs. 28

Profit% = 40%

**Formula used:**

Profit % = (Profit / Cost Price) x 100

**Solution:**

Let, cost price = CP

40 = (28 - CP)/CP x 100

40 = [(28/CP) - 1] x 100

40/100 = (28/ CP) - 1

0.4 + 1 = 28/CP

CP = 28/1.4 = 20

Cost price for 10 orange = 20Rs.

Cost price for 1 orang = 2 Rs.

1 Dozen = 12 orange = 2 x 12 = 24Rs.

**He will use 24Rs. to buy 12 oranges.**

questions.question: Raj’s monthly income was Rs.12,000 and his monthly expenditure was Rs.8,500. Next year his income increased by 10% and his expenditure increased by 10%. What was the percentage increase or decrease in his savings?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Previous Income = Rs. 12,000

Previous Expenditure = Rs.8,500

% increase in both = 10%

**Solution:**

New Income = 12,000 + 0.1(12000) = 13,200

New Expenditure = 8,500 + 0.1(8500) = 9,350

Earlier saving = 12000 - 8500 = 3,500

New saving = 13200 - 9350 = 3850

Change in saving = 3850 - 3500 = 350 Increase

**Percent increase in saving = 350/ 3500 x 100 = 10% increase**

questions.question: A chord of a circle of radius 21 cm makes a right angle at the center. Find the area of a major segment (take π = 22/7) closest to the nearest integer.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Radius = 21cm

The chord makes a right angle at the center.

**Formula used:**

Area of circle = pir²

Area of Triangle = 1/2 x base x height

Area of sector = {{pi times r² times theta } over 360^o}

Area of minor segment = Area of the minor sector - area of the triangle

Area of major segment = area of a circle - area of the minor segment

**Solution:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba421abd0bb4bc815e06afd9aca759bc41ef1bec3ded791ce766ae71aa2ef0a5.png] 

Area of circle = (22/7) x 21² = 1386cm²

Area of Triangle = 1/2 x 21 x 21 = 220.5cm²

Area of sector = {{{22over7} times 21² times 90^o } over 360^o} = 346.5cm²

Area of minor segment = 346.5 - 220.5 = 126cm²

**Area of major segment = 1386 - 126 = 1260cm²**

questions.question: A retailer marks up the price of his goods by 30%. He sells 50% of his goods at a discount of 8% and the remaining at a discount of 6%. Find his profit percentage.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Marked price = 130% of cost price

Discount% = 8% & 6% for 50% goods

**Formula used:**

Marked price = [Marked% / 100] x CP

Selling price = [Discount% / 100] x MP

Profit % = (Profit / Cost Price) x 100

Profit = SP - CP

**Solution:**

Let, cost price = CP 

So, marked price = 130/100 x CP = 1.3CP

The selling price of 50% goods at an 8% discount = [{{{(100-8) over 100} times 1.3CP} over 2}]

= 0.46 x 1.3CP = 0.598CP

The selling price of 50% goods at a 6% discount = [{{{(100-6) over 100} times 1.3CP} over 2}]

= 0.47 x 1.3CP = 0.611CP

Total selling price = (0.598+0.611)CP = 1.209CP

Profit = SP - CP = 1.209CP - CP = 0.209CP

**Profit% = [0.209CP / CP] x 100 = 20.9%**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**

**Concept Used:**

Weighted average for profit calculations.

**Calculation:**

Assume cost price of goods = 100 units

Markup = 30% of cost price

⇒ Marked price = 130 units

Selling price of first half of goods = 92% of marked price (due to 8% discount)

⇒ Effective selling price for this half = 0.92 × 130 = 119.6 units

Selling price of second half of goods = 94% of marked price (due to 6% discount)

⇒ Effective selling price for this half = 0.94 × 130 = 122 units

The average selling price (considering equal quantity sold at both discounts)

⇒ (119.6 + 122) / 2 = 120.8 units

Profit percentage = ((Selling price - Cost price) / Cost price) × 100

⇒ Profit percentage = ((120.8 - 100) / 100) × 100 = 20.9%

**Therefore, the retailer makes a profit of 20.9%.**

questions.question: A car travels at a speed of 40 km/h for 15 minutes and at a speed of 72 km/h for the next 5 minutes. The average speed of the car for the whole journey is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ride 1 = 40km/h for 15 minutes

Ride 2 = 72km/h for 5 minutes.

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance / Time

Average speed = Total Distance / Total Time taken

**Solution: **

15 minute = 1/4 hours

5 minute = 1/12 hours

For Ride 1, distance covered = 40 x (1/4) = 10km

For Ride 2, distance covered = 72 x (1/12) = 6km

Now,

Average speed = {{10 + 6} over {{1over4}+{1over12}}} = 16 x 3 = 48km/h

**Hence, the average speed 48km/h.**

questions.question: f the product 6352 × 7A1 is divisible by 12, then the value of A is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Number = 6352 x 7A1

Divisor = 12

**Fact used:**

Any number is divisible by 12, if the number is divisible by 4 and 3.

Any number is divisible by 3, if the sum of the digits is divisible by 3.

Any number is divisible by 4, if the last two digits are divisble by 4.

**Solution:**

here, 6352 is divisible by 4 as 52/4 = 13

So, the product is divisible by 12, if the 7A1 is divisible by 3.

Means, 7 + A + 1 = 3m ( m is any whole number)

A = (1, 4, 7)

If the value of A is any of the above, then it is divisible by 3.

**Hence, from the above, we can say that, A = 4, because the rest options 1 & 7 are not available.**

questions.question: X can complete a work in 5 days and Y in 10 days. If they work on it together for 2 days, then the fraction of the work that is left is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Efficiency(X) = 1/5

Efficiency(Y) = 1/10

Solution:

Efficiency(X+Y) in 2 days = 2 x (1/5 + 1/10) = 6/10 = 3/5

Hence, the work left = 1 - 3/5 = 2/5

**The fraction of work left is 2/5. **

questions.question: If a man deposits Rs. 12,100 in a bank at a simple interest of 15% per annum, then how much money will he receive from the bank after 3 years?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Type = Simple

Principle = Rs. 12,100

Rate = 15%

Time = 3 years

**Formula used:**

SI = (P x R x T) /100

A = SI + P

here, 

A = Amount

SI = Simple Interest

P = Principle

R = Rate

T = Time

**Solution:**

Let's put the values given, in the formula to find the value of SI;

SI = (12100 x 15 x 3) /100 = 5445

Now,

A = 12100 + 5445 = 17545

**Hence, he will get Rs. 17,545 at the end of 3rd year.**
